question: Should this protected PR be narrowed to unique dead-export work, or closed in favor of the focused replacement PRs?
rationale: The current head is dirty, contains broad unrelated changes, and overlaps two proof-positive focused PRs; selecting the canonical landing path requires explicit maintainer intent.

options.title: Use focused replacements
options.body: Land the applicable work through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/105945 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/105981, then close this overlapping branch.

options.title: Rebase and narrow this PR
options.body: Rebase onto current main, remove every unrelated runtime and dependency change, and retain only unique work not already covered by the focused PRs.

options.title: Keep combined scope
options.body: Retain the broad branch only after documenting every additional behavior change and providing complete dependency, Codex-contract, upgrade, and runtime proof.

recommendation.title: Use focused replacements
recommendation.body: Land the applicable work through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/105945 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/105981, then close this overlapping branch.
